verdict.rationale: There are several pinning mechanisms. The CLI installs at an exact version (ultrametric@0.4.1, confirmed by the hands-on version check). `init --dry-run` previews skill-file changes before writing them, and the resulting skill files can be committed so the team shares a fixed setup. Hosted process guides can be retrieved at a specific integer version. However, there is no lockfile or documented update policy, and nothing states that unpinned guide retrieval won't silently pick up the latest content. Missing for 10: a lockfile or manifest pinning guide versions team-wide, documented update and changelog notifications, explicit assurance against silent upstream changes to hosted guides, and independent corroboration.
